players.name: Alexander Zverev
players.intro: Alexander Zverev is a super-tall star from Germany. His friends call him Sascha. He is the number 1 seed, the top ranking badge here.
players.story: Sascha comes from a tennis family. His mom, dad, and big brother Mischa were all pros. His dad has coached him since he was little. In 2026 he finally won the French Open. That is a Grand Slam, one of the four biggest tournaments.

funFacts.text: He is 6 feet 6 inches tall. That is really, really tall!
He travels with a grey poodle named Lovik. Lovik even had his own tournament pass!
He speaks three languages: German, Russian, and English.
He loves basketball. His favorite player ever is Dwyane Wade.
He met Roger Federer at age five and got his autograph. Years later he beat Federer in a real match!
He won Olympic gold in Tokyo in 2021.
In his free time he plays golf and video games.

players.name: Elena Rybakina
players.intro: Elena Rybakina plays for Kazakhstan. She is the number 2 seed, a ranking badge for top players. Fans call her the Ice Queen because she stays so calm.
players.story: As a little girl, Elena did gymnastics and ice skating. Then she grew too tall, so she tried tennis instead! In 2022 she won Wimbledon, and in 2026 the Australian Open. Those are Grand Slams, the four biggest tournaments. She was the first player from Kazakhstan ever to win one.

funFacts.text: Her serve can zoom at 127 miles per hour. That is faster than a car on the highway.
She hit 516 aces in 2025. An ace is a serve nobody even touches!
She has a beagle named Mulia. She has visited animal shelters to help pets find homes.
She once met a kangaroo in Australia and posted the photo.
She went to a regular school and practiced tennis only two hours a day.
She is shy and quiet, but she loves posting pictures of desserts.

players.story: At age three, Alex hit backhands against the family garage door. His mom hit with him almost every day. He says she is like a wall! At 18 he skipped college and reached a pro final right away. On Friday he won in straight sets, so he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: Both his parents played college tennis. His mom hit with him almost every day.
His favorite movie is Star Wars. His favorite book is Harry Potter.
He loves video games. He plays them against his pal Learner Tien, another player.
He plays basketball for fun and cheers for the Lakers.
His favorite ice cream flavor is plain vanilla.
He won the Wimbledon boys' doubles title in 2022 with his friend Sebastian.

players.watchFor: Watch his two-handed backhand rip straight down the line for a winner!
